about: Tasks per role for /find-my-task. pile: does = AI does it (handedOver >= 60), mixed = use your judgment (41 to 59), helps = AI assists, you verify (<= 40), unknown = no published data (not zero). handedOver = share of Claude.ai conversations about the task where people handed it over: automation / (automation + augmentation), April and May 2026 pooled by usage. rare = usage share rounds to 0.0% in every month, so treat the % as a hint. label = short plain-English rewrite of the O*NET task (onet).
